Publish.LongDescription:
# Zoning By-Law Builder
**Keep in mind this mod is in beta, and might have bugs.**
**Beta Feature Reel - [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_PaNeeFAT-w)**
Using the constraint-based Zoning By-Law builder, craft the city of your dreams.
Only want buildings of a certain height? How about requiring surface parking? Maybe wanna mix all the W2W buildings across regions into one zone? All that and more is possible with the Zoning By-Law Builder.
# Upcoming Features
- Localization - Icons for By-Laws - New Constraints: - Asset Pack - Region - Height-to-Setback Ratio - Storage Building - Preview buildings as you create the By-Law - City/District Policy to ensure building upgrades match By-Laws
# Limitations
- This mod **does not** edit or create new buildings. When you zone a constraint-based zone, the system will try to find a building that fits the constraints. - Currently the mod does not take your unlock progress into account, so buildings above your level might appear in your city. - Parking requirements don't fully account for garages (this is because they currently don't function in vanilla). - When a building upgrades, it might not conform to the by-law, a future City/District policy will change that.
# Special Thanks To:
✨T.D.W ✨Yenyang ✨City Planner Plays ✨Konsi ✨Klyte ✨Krzychu ✨Quboid ✨Triton Supreme and the Cities: Skylines Modding Discord community
# Known Issues
- Corner buildings spawn on a non-corner lot (this might be vanilla behaviour that the mod brings out more) - Scrollbar is invisible in editor (it's there, so you can use the mouse wheel or guess where it is)
## Bug Reporting and Discussions
Please report bug reports and have discussions on the mod's thread in the [Cities: Skylines Modding Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1024242828114673724/1335344332797907148).
